## MOSS-Image Depth Control

MOSS-Image can be steered by a depth map: the **MOSS-Image Color/Depth Control** node injects the map into the image tokens, and the LoRA loaded just before it (`moss_image_color_depth_control.safetensors`, strength 1.0) is what makes the model read that map. Remove the LoRA and the node does nothing.

**How to use it**

1. Replace the image in **LoadImage (depth map, near = white)** with your own map: greyscale, near = white, far = black.
2. Keep **Upscale Image (match output size)** wired and give it the same width and height as **Empty Flux 2 Latent** (896 × 1184 here). The model does not rescale the map for you, so a mismatched size breaks the control.
3. Describe the same scene in **Positive Prompt**: the map fixes geometry, the prompt decides content, lighting and style.
4. `strength` 1.0 is the trained strength and 0.0 is the same as sending no map. `start_percent` and `end_percent` choose which part of the sampling run is controlled: ending at 0.6 keeps the depth layout while the last steps render detail freely.
5. `end_percent` in practice: on this map (real photo → Depth Anything 3, seed 77, 25 steps) the generated image agrees with the input map at rho 0.75 with `end_percent` 0.6 and 0.76 with 1.0, while 0.2 falls to 0.65, so the depth layout is already settled well before step 15 and anything from 0.6 to 1.0 holds it. Raise it to **1.0 for a depth map estimated from a real photograph** when you want the geometry pinned all the way to the last step; use **about 0.5 for 3D/CGI or synthetic maps**, whose hard synthetic gradients otherwise fight the model's own shading (the ComfyUI PR test graph ships 0.6 with a synthetic map). The default here stays 0.6 as a safe middle.
6. Depth maps come from any estimator: this one was produced from the reference photo with **Run Depth Anything 3** (mono mode) and then rendered with **Render Depth Anything 3** (output `depth`).

**Painting your own map**: swap **LoadImage (depth map, near = white)** for a **Painter** node (category `image`, output `IMAGE` plus a `MASK`) and paint directly on its canvas: white for near, black for far. Painting smooth gradients keeps the control strong; a map with a few hard bands is much weaker at `strength` 1.0 and needs roughly 1.5 to 2.0, and its hard edges come back as literal object edges in the output; with a painted map also lower `end_percent` to about 0.5 so the model can rework the shading once the bands are placed. The same applies to the `color_map` input: it takes one flat colour per region, where the colours only act as region IDs. This template shows the depth path only.

## Model Links

- [Hugging Face: Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image)

**diffusion_models**

- [moss_image_sft_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image/resolve/main/diffusion_models/moss_image_sft_int8_convrot.safetensors)
- [moss_image_base_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image/resolve/main/diffusion_models/moss_image_base_int8_convrot.safetensors): the base checkpoint runs in the same graph

**text_encoders**

- [qwen3.5_9b_w4a8_gptq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3.5_9b_w4a8_gptq.safetensors)

**vae**

- [flux2-vae_small.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image/resolve/main/vae/flux2-vae_small.safetensors)

**loras**

- [moss_image_color_depth_control.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image/resolve/main/loras/moss_image_color_depth_control.safetensors)

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── moss_image_sft_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen3.5_9b_w4a8_gptq.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   └── flux2-vae_small.safetensors
│   └── 📂 loras/
│       └── moss_image_color_depth_control.safetensors
```

## Sampling

25 steps, CFG 3, `er_sde` / `simple`, shift 5, skip layer guidance on single layer 24, temporal score rescaling 0.95. These follow the MOSS-Image control test graph shipped with the ComfyUI PR; the official MOSS-Image defaults (50 steps, CFG 3) trade speed for polish.

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)
